channel.title: References :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Full citations for sources referenced throughout this site, in IEEE style, alphabetical by first author. Each entry has a stable anchor; in-text citations elsewhere on the site link here by name (e.g. #bruner-1960), not by number, so the list can grow without breaking existing links. Akkerman & Bakker, 2011 S. F. Akkerman and A. Bakker, “Boundary crossing and boundary objects,” Review of Educational Research, vol. 81, no. 2, pp. 132–169, 2011.
